name: Copper/Gold Ratio Momentum – SPY Long/Flat
description: Macro regime strategy that goes long SPY when the copper/gold ratio 60-day ROC is above 0% (ratio rising at all), and stays flat otherwise. Uses HG/GC futures with NoAdjustment continuation. Position: 100% SPY when long, 0% when flat. Daily signal recalculation.
source:
# Copper/Gold Ratio Momentum – SPY Long/Flat Strategy
# Signal: Long SPY when 60-day ROC of copper/gold ratio > 10%
# Flat otherwise — pure macro regime filter
#
# Copper/gold ratio is a classic risk appetite barometer:
#   Rising ratio → economic expansion, risk-on → long equities
#   Falling ratio → economic slowdown, risk-off → stay flat

# --- Primary asset data (SPY) ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Reference futures for copper (HG) and gold (GC) ---
# NoAdjustment preserves true price levels for cross-commodity ratio
hg_ref = reference_futures(ticker="HG")()
hg_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(hg_ref.o, hg_ref.h, hg_ref.l, hg_ref.c, hg_ref.v, hg_ref.oi, hg_ref.s)

gc_ref = reference_futures(ticker="GC")()
gc_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment)(gc_ref.o, gc_ref.h, gc_ref.l, gc_ref.c, gc_ref.v, gc_ref.oi, gc_ref.s)

# Forward-fill to handle weekends/holidays in reference data
copper_close = ffill(hg_cont.c)
gold_close = ffill(gc_cont.c)

# --- Copper/Gold ratio and 60-day rate of change ---
cu_au_ratio = copper_close / gold_close

# roc() returns decimal fraction: 0.10 = 10%
roc_60d = roc(period=60)(cu_au_ratio)

# --- Signal logic ---
# Long SPY when ratio momentum is strong (ROC > 10%)
# Flat when momentum fades (ROC <= 10%)
signal_on = roc_60d > 0.0
signal_off = roc_60d <= 0.0

# Persist signal state between crossings
held_long = hold_until()(enter=signal_on, exit=signal_off)

# --- Execution: long-only, 100% allocation when signal is active ---
# rollover_policy required by validator when futures_continuation is present
# No-op for SPY (stock), but satisfies the contract routing requirement
rollover_policy()(active=hg_cont.s)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
